title: Paju City Tour 2026: DMZ and Day Courses by Weekday, Prices and Pickup at Hongik Univ. Station
description: Paju City Tour guide, checked October 2026: a different day course each weekday (KRW 7,000–21,000), the Friday DMZ Peace Tour and Imjingak Peace Gondola course, the KRW 80,000 overnight tour, pickups at Hongik University Station 09:00, and the season (24 March–29 November).
h1Sub: Courses by weekday, prices and pickup points
lead: The Paju City Tour is a bookable tour bus run by Paju City that also picks up in Seoul at Hongik University Station. Each day from Tuesday to Sunday has its own course: Friday goes to the Imjingak Peace Gondola and the DMZ Peace Tour, Saturday to Odusan Unification Observatory and Heyri Art Village, and Wednesday and Sunday to the Majang Lake suspension bridge.
summary: 24 March – 29 November 2026 · no service in July and August

priceNote: Fares from the Paju City tourism portal on 29 October 2026. Lunch, some admission fees and travel insurance are not included. The overnight tour is twin share; single rooms cost extra.
howToBook: Book the course and date on the official site (Korean) with the button below and pay by card, or call 02-730-0531.
Tours run with at least 10 people (overnight 8); if not, they are cancelled 3 days before with a full refund.
For the DMZ Peace Tour bring your passport; check entry rules with the operator when booking.
howToRide: Wait at Hongik Univ. Station exit 3 (09:00), Unjeong Station exit 1 bus stop (09:40) or GTX-A Unjeong Jungang Station exit 2 (10:00).
The bus visits the sights in order; lunch is on your own at the lunch stop.

faq.q: Does the Paju City Tour go to the DMZ?
faq.a: Yes. The Friday course includes the Imjingak Peace Gondola and the DMZ Peace Tour, and so does day two of the overnight tour.
Yes. The bus leaves Hongik University Station exit 3 at 09:00.
From 24 March to 29 November 2026, Tuesday to Sunday, with no service in July and August.
KRW 7,000 (Tue, Sat, Sun), 14,000 (Wed), 18,000 (Fri) or 21,000 (Thu); the overnight tour is KRW 80,000.
